capabilities: render GitHub-style activity heatmaps from Dataview queries
require date and value fields in query results for intensity
override heatmap options per query (title, daysToShow, labels, gradient)
lock the heatmap scale with minValue and maxValue
add custom color palettes in settings
extras: The README notes the graph can look squished and provides a CSS snippet to give it more space; custom date ranges are listed as upcoming. The manifest states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to visualize activity over time, such as notes created or numeric fields tracked per day, as a heatmap.

relations.evidence: Render activity heatmaps from Dataview query results.

summary: Renders GitHub-style activity heatmaps from Dataview query results inside activity-graph code blocks.
